_readme: Site glossary for en/ (v2). shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the 13 sites; terms = Tailscale / Home Assistant app domain terms for THIS site (upstream wording wins: tailscale.com/kb, tailscale.com/docs, hassio-addons/app-tailscale DOCS.md); keepEnglish = never translate/rephrase; forbid = words the reviewer rejects. decisions.* = binding cross-chapter wording agreed before the 12 chapters + 5 hub pages are translated in parallel: h2 forms, data-nav labels, callout labels, table headers, code placeholders, localize substitutions, and the identical boilerplate blocks that every chapter shares. Plain-text twin: /home/user/out/terms_ha_tailscale.txt.
principles: Upstream English UI/docs wording wins (headscale.net, tailscale.com/kb).
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-…> style.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.
Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; 第 N 章 → Chapter N; 圖 N-M → Figure N-M.

This site is about the OFFICIAL Tailscale service used from the Home Assistant Tailscale app. 'admin console', 'Machines', 'device approval', 'key expiry', 'subnet router', 'Serve', 'Funnel', 'MagicDNS' follow tailscale.com wording; 'Apps', 'Settings -> Apps', 'Supervisor', 'HAOS' follow Home Assistant wording.

Nine chapter sections (concept, steps, choices, security, test, record, troubleshoot, faq, sources) and the second lead sentence are byte-identical in all 12 zh chapters. Translate them ONCE (ch1) and paste the same English into every other chapter; they must not drift.
'App' (chapters) and 'add-on' (sales/prompts/skills) both appear in the zh source. Follow the page: app in the chapters, add-on where the zh says add-on. Do not normalize one into the other.

Hub pages: sales.html is transcreate (no Taiwan-only framing, contact channel and prices are placeholders), prompts.html is rewrite (prompts ask for English output, true prompt count = 44), skills.html is translate.

decisions._readme: Binding cross-chapter wording. If a page can render a phrase two ways, use the form here. h2_by_section is keyed by section id; h2_exact lists every distinct zh h2 on the site in full because they must not drift. identical_blocks names the sections that are byte-identical across all 12 chapters and must be pasted, not re-translated. site_strings covers chrome that lives in chapters.json (owner: chapters.json editor) and hub-page brand/kicker/button text.
